records.title: Convergence Characteristics of the Cumulant Expansion for Fourier Path Integrals
confirmed_mechanisms: Expectation of an exponential is represented by a cumulant log series.
First cumulant is the mean, second cumulant is the variance.
Partial averaging is first-order cumulant approximation; higher terms correct it.
limits: Paper studies imaginary-time density matrices and Fourier path variables, not our lattice jump-bridge implementation.
The stated N^(-(2p+1)) result concerns number of Fourier path variables at fixed cumulant order; it is not a guarantee of convergence as cumulant order increases.

records.title: Meta-learning Pseudo-differential Operators with Deep Neural Networks
confirmed_mechanisms: Predicted operator W S[C_eta] W^T remains linear in forcing f.
Training uses parameter, forcing, solution triples without full operator matrices.
Learned wavelet representation and convolutional parameter encoder, with multiscale sparse operator action.
Reports operator norm error in addition to response errors.
limits: Primarily elliptic Green functions and radiative transfer, not our finite-time heterogeneous reaction tangent propagator.
Nonlinear state conditioning plus forcing linearity alone is a direct prior-art overlap.

records.title: Low-Rank Kolmogorov-Arnold Generator Flows for Interpretable Operator Learning
relevant_sections: Supplement Text S1 Exactness of linear flow
confirmed_mechanisms: Generator combines translation-invariant spectral multiplier, sum of spatial coefficients times Fourier multipliers, and nonlinear component.
Low symbol separation rank of finite-order variable-coefficient generators is independent of grid resolution.
Explicitly states this rank result does not extend to finite-time propagators.
Gauge fixing centers spatial coefficients and subtracts constant and linear parts of nonlinear component.
Lawson integrating-factor RK4 with exact stiff linear exponential and 2/3 dealiasing; quantum dynamics use Strang splitting with input/output spatial factors.
Reports Adam warmup, validation selection, L-BFGS refinement, and symbolic distillation.
limits: Exact stiff linear flow does not make the full nonlinear evolution or Strang approximation exact.
New preprint results are author-reported, not independently reproduced here.
KAFlow code, trained models, and new generators are stated to be available from corresponding author upon reasonable request; official KANO assets are linked publicly.
Two-sided spatial factors and finite-time deployment alone are not sufficient novelty distinctions.
